stories.title: Anthropic Debuts on Wall Street as a $2 Trillion Company
stories.summary: Anthropic, a San Francisco-based AI lab, recently debuted on Wall Street. The company was initially valued at $2 trillion, marking a significant event for the tech industry, though it concluded its first day with a valuation of $1.7 trillion.

stories.title: Apple Is Coming For OpenAI And Anthropic With An AI Agent That Can Control Your Computer: Report
stories.summary: Apple is reportedly developing an AI agent capable of browsing the web, writing code, and controlling applications autonomously. This development positions Apple to compete with major AI players like OpenAI, Anthropic, and Google.

stories.title: How Jensen Huang Made Humiliation Routine at Nvidia
stories.summary: Nvidia co-founder Jensen Huang has a long history of belittling employees, which once resulted in a confidential settlement with an executive who accused him of terrorizing staff. This behavior has been a consistent aspect of his leadership over decades.

stories.title: Nvidia Brings RTX Spark AI PCs To India, With Laptops Starting At Rs 2.99 Lakh
stories.summary: Nvidia is introducing RTX Spark AI PCs to India, with a range of laptops starting at Rs 2.99 lakh. Major manufacturers such as Asus, Dell, HP, Lenovo, and MSI are offering laptops and compact desktops featuring the new superchip.

stories.title: Dell launches XPS 16 Creator Edition in India, its first XPS laptop with NVIDIA RTX Spark, at Rs 4,49,990
stories.summary: Dell has launched its XPS 16 Creator Edition in India, which is the first XPS laptop from the company to feature NVIDIA RTX Spark. The new laptop is priced at Rs 4,49,990.

stories.title: Anthropic Shares Slip as AI and Tech Stock Sell-Off Continues
stories.summary: Anthropic's shares declined on their second day of trading, contributing to a wider sell-off in technology stocks. This trend put the S&P 500 and Nasdaq on track for their most significant weekly losses in over a year.

stories.title: Nvidia Asked to Sell Chips to Companies Tied to Chinese Military and Megaspeed
stories.summary: Confidential information released by lawmakers indicates that the Commerce Department approved the sale of over 800,000 A.I. chips to Chinese companies. Some of these companies reportedly have connections to the Chinese military.

stories.title: US Stock Market: Dow Falls Below 50,000, Nasdaq Drops 2% As Anthropic IPO Fails To Revive AI Trade
stories.summary: US markets experienced a sharp decline, with the Dow Jones closing below 50,000 and the Nasdaq dropping 2%. This occurred as AI stocks continued to face pressure, even with the significant Anthropic listing.

stories.title: EPFO Approves PF Withdrawal Reform: 90% Corpus Withdrawal Allowed, 10% Minimum Balance
stories.summary: A significant reform in PF withdrawal has been approved by EPFO. This change allows members to withdraw up to 90 percent of their eligible corpus, provided they maintain a minimum balance of 10 percent.

stories.title: Tata Trusts Approves Rs 50 Crore Grant For Jehangir Hospital Ahead Of Tata Sons Board Meeting
stories.summary: Tata Trusts has approved a grant of Rs 50 crore for Jehangir Hospital. This decision comes before an important Tata Sons board meeting, drawing attention to the conglomerate's governance and trust-related activities.

stories.title: Trump Flaunts Camaraderie With Xi and Putin but Has Little to Show for It
stories.summary: President Trump expressed a friendly relationship with the leaders of Russia and China during his first trilateral summit. Despite the show of camaraderie, the summit did not result in any significant progress on issues such as nuclear control, the conflict in Ukraine, or artificial intelligence.

stories.title: Top White House Cybersecurity Official Is Replaced
stories.summary: The White House's top cybersecurity official, Sean Cairncross, has been replaced. This change follows recent technological disruptions that impacted both U.S. businesses and government agencies.

stories.title: Wave of Russian strikes hit across Ukraine as Trump-Xi-Putin summit wraps up in China
stories.summary: A series of Russian strikes occurred across Ukraine as a summit involving Trump, Xi, and Putin concluded in China.

stories.title: 'India has become a side player': Rahul attacks PM Modi's foreign policy, cites Pak's role in Iran-US tal
stories.summary: Rahul Gandhi criticized Prime Minister Modi's foreign policy, stating that India has become a less influential player and referencing Pakistan's involvement in discussions between Iran and the U.S.

stories.title: Bulldozer Turns Killer at Akhilesh Yadav's Roadshow: Yogi Vows Action After BJP Leader's 13-Year-Old Son Gets
stories.summary: A bulldozer was involved in an incident during Akhilesh Yadav's roadshow, resulting in the death of a 13-year-old son of a BJP leader. Yogi Adityanath has promised action regarding the event.

stories.title: Judge Blocks DHS Restrictions on International Student Internships
stories.summary: A judge has blocked restrictions imposed by the Department of Homeland Security (DHS) concerning internships for international students. This decision impacts the ability of these students to participate in practical training experiences in the United States.

stories.title: Federal judge throws out plan to limit how long international students can stay in U.S.
stories.summary: A federal judge has rejected a proposal that aimed to limit the duration of stay for international students in the United States. This ruling means that previous plans to restrict how long these students can remain in the country will not be implemented.

stories.title: H-1B visa holders in Texas may get relief as governor-elect vows to reverse Abbott's restrictive hiring policy | Hindustan Times
stories.summary: The governor-elect in Texas has pledged to overturn Governor Abbott's hiring policy, which has been restrictive for H-1B visa holders. This could provide relief for individuals working in Texas on H-1B visas.

stories.title: H-1B delays and fees are pushing tech workers out of the US, Bloomberg reports
stories.summary: Delays and increased fees associated with H-1B visas are reportedly causing tech workers to leave the United States. This situation suggests a potential impact on the tech industry's workforce in the country.

stories.title: H-1B visa workers' children could get Green Card pathway under this US Bill
stories.summary: A new US Bill proposes a pathway for the children of H-1B visa workers to obtain Green Cards. If passed, this legislation could offer a route to permanent residency for these individuals.
